name: limit-band
description: A thin line above the prompt for the 5-hour usage limit, colored by pace (where it would end at the current rate), with its time to reset, a tick at the window's clock and the 7-day limit beside it

orange_used.title: Orange once used
orange_used.description: Turn orange once this much of the 5-hour limit is used, whatever the pace.

red_used.title: Red once used
red_used.description: Turn red once this much of the 5-hour limit is used, whatever the pace.

orange_pace.title: Orange from projected
orange_pace.description: Turn orange when the current rate would end the window at this share of the limit (used % over the share of the window gone).

red_pace.title: Red from projected
red_pace.description: Turn red when the current rate would end the window at this share of the limit.
